banker_outreach: Hi Simone, Dana Kirkwood (NMLS: 2125038) with Rocket Mortgage (NMLS: 3030). I noticed you started exploring your options online. I'd love to help you pick up where you left off and find the right solution for you. What questions can I answer?
client_inbound: I'm interested — can you tell me more about cash-out options? Because, you know Dana, I recently spoke with Priscilla and explained to her about how I've been paying the principle down aggressively and that in fact my equity should be reflecting $65K now. Priscilla assured me that the figures would be updated in the system. I think I talked to her about a day or so ago. Confirm that we're all updated in the system please? Once we have that new number established then we can totally move forward and start exploring options. Thank you so much Dana, God bless!

nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and refinance-ready — the play calls for speed and a frictionless path to application, not re-selling. The FHA-to-conventional refi angle (eliminating $90/mo PMI plus potential rate improvement from 6.99%) is already compelling; the job now is to move them straight to the soft pull, not ask more questions.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to what they asked — no generic opener, no re-pitch
  - Acknowledge their current situation in one line: FHA at 6.99%, $1,461/mo P&I, plus $90/mo MI on top
  - Do not ask discovery questions they've already answered

- Lead with the concrete opportunity in their numbers
  - Their all-in payment today includes $90/mo in mortgage insurance that a conventional refi could eliminate entirely
  - On a $218,463 balance, even a modest rate improvement compounds on top of that MI savings — let the real numbers do the work once you run them
  - Do not state a new rate or savings figure you haven't locked in yet; instead say 'let me pull your exact numbers'

- Move straight to the soft credit pull — make it one tap
  - Send the e-sign / soft pull link in the same message or the very next one
  - Frame it as the fastest way to show them their actual new payment: 'Takes 2 minutes, no impact to your credit score, and I can show you your exact new payment right after'

- Keep the message short — one screen, no walls of text
  - This client has already bought in; over-explaining kills momentum
  - Single clear call to action: click the link or confirm a 10-minute call if they prefer to talk first
